sourceFiles: 2026 CONTRACT RATES/KENYA/ACCOMODATION/OFFBEAT/2026 Offbeat Collection Wholesale Rates (30%) AMENDED.pdf
notes: Part of the same 8-property Offbeat document - see offbeat-mara-camp-2026.json for sibling properties.
Only property in this set with a single year-round season ('ONE SEASON').
Two room categories: Standard Room (Main House) and Cottage Room - Cottage only used when main house rooms unavailable.
Wholesale rate confirmed arithmetically as Rack x 0.70 (e.g. Standard adult: $441 = $630 x 0.70).
validityConfidenceNote: [Unverified] Source PDF literally states this 2-year validity window ('Valid 01 Jan 2026 to 31 Dec 2027'), unlike every other property in this document (which use Jan-Dec single-year or Jan-Jan windows). Could be a genuine 2-year rate lock or a typo for 31 Dec 2026 - not reconciled, quoted as printed.
specials: Early Bird Discount: 5% off accommodation, deposit 9 months prior. Year-round, combinable with 2.
Family Discount: 3rd child (4-11yrs) sharing a triple pays conservancy fees only. Year-round, combinable with 1.
includes: Walking on the farm and forest
excludes: Special request riding and polo lessons: $40/hour
Day visits to Lake Nakuru or Lake Bogoria (incl. lunch & park fees): price on request

policies.deposit: 20% deposit confirms booking; balance due 45 days prior to arrival.
policies.cancellation: >120 days: 20% deposit refunded (net of bank charges); 120-46 days: 20% deposit forfeited; 45-30 days: 50% of full booking value forfeited; <30 days or no-show: 100% forfeited.
